Czech Extraliga (ELH) game ids of a season

Source: R/elh.R
elh_game_ids.Rd

Every hokej.cz game id with a play-by-play file in a season, paging the S3 listing. Lists match/{season - 1}/full/ (the bucket files a season under its START year) a thousand keys at a time, following marker until the listing is complete.

Usage

elh_game_ids(season)

Arguments

season

Season by its END year (2027 = 2026-27). Play-by-play starts in 2014-15 (season 2015).

Value

A tibble, one row per file, ordered by game id:

col_nametypedescription
hokejcz_game_idintegerhokej.cz game id (the S3 file name; shots match.id, scoreboard hokejcz_id). integer.
seasonintegerSeason END year as requested (2027 = 2026-27).
keycharacterS3 object key, e.g. match/2026/full/2928255.json.
last_modifiedcharacterLast write of the object, ISO-8601 UTC.
sizeintegerObject size in bytes (a few hundred bytes = a file written ahead of the game).

Details

The bucket is NOT Extraliga-only. A season folder holds every competition hokej.cz shows (Maxa liga, lower leagues, juniors, the national team): about 2,000 to 6,000 ids against about 400 ELH games, plus files written ahead of a game (a few hundred bytes; see size). The listing carries no league, so these ids are NOT filtered: check a game's teams with elh_shots() / elh_pbp(), or, for a day still in the scoreboard's rolling window, keep the ids elh_scoreboard() lists.

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: the season folder holds no play-by-play file. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: a page failed, is not a listing, or the listing does not advance. fastRhockey_bad_request: season is not a year.

See also

Other ELH Functions: elh_events(), elh_list_objects(), elh_pbp(), elh_pbp_goals(), elh_pbp_latest(), elh_pbp_mobile(), elh_scoreboard(), elh_shots()

Examples

# \donttest{
  try(elh_game_ids(season = 2027))
